description: This file defines the class 'OneToOneRelationship', which manages the metadata and vardef building logic for one-to-one relationships within the SuiteCRM framework. It extends 'AbstractRelationship' and provides methods to build relationship metadata, vardefs (including link and relate fields), and layout fields for modules involved in the relationship.

classes.name: OneToOneRelationship
classes.description: A class to manage the metadata and vardef definitions for a one-to-one relationship between modules in SuiteCRM. It includes methods to build relationship metadata, link and relate field definitions, and layout fields for the involved modules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a relationship definition, passing it to the parent class.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Builds and returns the relationship metadata array for the involved modules.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Constructs and returns vardef definitions, including link and relate fields, for both modules involved in the relationship.

methods.name: buildFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Defines which relationship fields should be added to module layouts; avoids duplicates in recursive relationships.
